explanationMd: A polyatomic ion contains several covalently connected atoms with an overall charge. Ammonium contains one nitrogen and four hydrogens and has net charge +1. The other listed ions are each single atoms carrying charge.

distractorRationale.e: This ion contains a single oxygen atom.
